threads.body: This generated entry should point to OkHttp’s official replacement website, `https://lysine.dev/okhttp/`, rather than the source repository. That also keeps it consistent with the documented `library_link` rule to prefer a project’s main website or documentation over GitHub.

   - HTTP_CLIENT_SPANS
   - HTTP_CLIENT_METRICS
-  library_link: https://square.github.io/okhttp/
+  library_link: https://github.com/lysine-dev/okhttp/

threads.body: The repository is not the project’s main website: OkHttp’s repository metadata and README identify `https://lysine.dev/okhttp/` as the official project website. The repository’s instrumentation documentation also requires `library_link` to prefer the main website/documentation over GitHub (`docs/contributing/documenting-instrumentation.md:213-216`), so this should use the new documentation URL instead.
